newsitem.title: UK: British publications auditor, ABC, restructures.
newsitem.headline: British publications auditor, ABC, restructures.

text.p: Britain's Audit Bureau of Circulation (ABC), which tracks and verifies the circulation figures of publications, said on Thursday it was restructuring.
"After 60 years of being a non-profit-making organisation, the new target is to achieve an operating surplus each year," it said in its quarterly newsletter.
ABC said it would use the surplus to promote the benefits of audited circulation information to advertisers and advertising agencies.
The organisation will also move into auditing the circulation of new media such as web sites as its customers move into these markets.
